user.title: Connect to SalahOS
user.description: Connect Home Assistant to a read-only SalahOS published mosque endpoint.

data_description.url: The HTTP or HTTPS base URL that serves the SalahOS /api/v1 public contract.
data_description.mosque_id: The stable public mosque identifier, for example masjid.one.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to read the published mosque profile from this SalahOS endpoint.
error.invalid_input: The URL or mosque ID is invalid.

abort.already_configured: This SalahOS mosque endpoint is already configured.
